description: Source code for NVRAM variable manipulation, including functions for reading, writing, hashing, and managing NVRAM data structures, as well as handling device-specific operations like finding device nodes and staging files.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Computes a hash value for a string, used for NVRAM variable lookup.

methods.name: _nvram_free
methods.description: Frees all NVRAM tuples and hash table entries.

methods.name: _nvram_realloc
methods.description: Allocates or reallocates an NVRAM tuple with given name and value.

methods.name: _nvram_rehash
methods.description: Reinitializes the hash table based on current NVRAM data.

methods.name: nvram_header
methods.description: Retrieves the NVRAM header from a handle.

methods.name: nvram_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an NVRAM variable by name.

methods.name: nvram_set
methods.description: Sets the value of an NVRAM variable.

methods.name: nvram_getall
methods.description: Returns all NVRAM variables as a linked list.

methods.name: nvram_commit
methods.description: Regenerates and writes the NVRAM data to storage.

methods.name: nvram_open
methods.description: Opens and maps the NVRAM device, returning a handle.

methods.name: nvram_close
methods.description: Closes the NVRAM handle and frees resources.

methods.name: nvram_find_mtd
methods.description: Finds the device node for the NVRAM device.

methods.name: nvram_find_staging
methods.description: Checks for the existence of a staging file for NVRAM.

methods.name: nvram_to_staging
methods.description: Copies NVRAM contents to a staging file.

methods.name: staging_to_nvram
methods.description: Copies staging file contents back to NVRAM device.
